searchText: Hey guys, I been here in discussing the EIP1559 but I am also interested in doing some potential work on ETH/ with ETH. I can do python, R and soon Java - what are the required languages and tooling to start with some simple stuff on ETH? Is there a page i can go to? I found the website, https://ethereum.org/en/developers/tutorials/, going to see if i can do some of the stuff here 🙂 <@!725050506808131635> I was just about to say, there's a page full of python things on that site somewhere. It's getting more popular to write smart-contract tests/peripherals in Python, but Python is limited otherwise. For Java things you'll probably want to look at the java Web3 bindings, Besu (eth1), or Teku (eth2). Yeah sorry, jumped too quickly on writing something here. No worries, wish more devs posted here, it's a good place to start here Thank you for your reply 😄 <@!725050506808131635> if you want to contribute to a Java client, you can find Good First Issues here: Eth1: https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/labels/good%20first%20issue Eth2: https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/labels/good%20first%20issue%20%3Araising_hand%3A thanks <@!552133098075193354>

It's getting more popular to write smart-contract tests/peripherals in Python, but Python is limited otherwise. For Java things you'll probably want to look at the java Web3 bindings, Besu (eth1), or Teku (eth2).
